aspect_catalog.label: Requirements and product fit
aspect_catalog.prompt: Does the change satisfy the user request without scope drift?

aspect_catalog.label: Core logic
aspect_catalog.prompt: Are the main algorithms, data flow, and invariants correct?

aspect_catalog.label: Edge cases and contracts
aspect_catalog.prompt: Do boundary values, empty inputs, errors, concurrency, and API contracts hold?

aspect_catalog.label: Tests and regressions
aspect_catalog.prompt: Do tests prove the changed behavior and relevant failure paths?

aspect_catalog.label: Security, privacy, and secrets
aspect_catalog.prompt: Are auth, secrets, private data, injection, paths, and dependencies safe?

aspect_catalog.label: LLM and tool trust boundaries
aspect_catalog.prompt: Are model/tool outputs treated as untrusted and are external actions bounded?

aspect_catalog.label: Data integrity, encoding, migrations, and backcompat
aspect_catalog.prompt: Are stored data, encodings, formats, migrations, and old outputs preserved?

aspect_catalog.label: Integration, runtime, reliability, and cleanup
aspect_catalog.prompt: Does this work in the real runtime with correct resource cleanup and retries?

aspect_catalog.label: Observability, logs, metrics, and debuggability
aspect_catalog.prompt: Can failures be diagnosed without leaking secrets or hiding root causes?

aspect_catalog.label: Performance, cost, and scalability
aspect_catalog.prompt: Does the change avoid avoidable slow paths, duplicate work, and waste?

aspect_catalog.label: UX, UI, accessibility, and i18n
aspect_catalog.prompt: Does the user-facing behavior remain clear, reachable, and language-safe?

aspect_catalog.label: Developer experience, docs, API, and examples
aspect_catalog.prompt: Would a maintainer or caller know how to use and verify this change?

aspect_catalog.label: Release, deploy, rollback, and CI
aspect_catalog.prompt: Are deployment, CI, rollback, and versioning implications handled?

aspect_catalog.label: Domain-specific risk and compliance
aspect_catalog.prompt: Are domain rules, client data, legal/business constraints, and project policies respected?

aspect_passes.notes: Stage 2 scope matches the approved service-boundary increment; no live protection actions.
Role/name, authoritative-writer, startup, and state invariants reviewed; mismatch finding fixed.
Malformed frames, disconnects, token failures, rollback, and concurrency are bounded and tested.
Pure harnesses cover service, storage, crypto, account, IPC, policy, readiness, protocol, and legacy containment.
Security guidance gate completed; pipe instance, ACL ordering, and critical leaf ACL findings fixed.
Product code contains no LLM or agent tool boundary.
Versioned bounded canonical state and protocol codecs fail closed on unknown or corrupt data.
SCM lifecycle, LocalSystem gate, zero-gap listener handoff, rollback cleanup, and disposal reviewed.
Fatal startup/runtime failures produce nonzero status and host logging without payload or secret disclosure.
State and frame sizes are bounded; singleton limiter and serial endpoint lifecycle avoid unbounded work.
This increment has no user interface.
Project layout, exact SDK/package lock, and explicit fail-closed placeholders are self-describing; plan update follows commit.
Exact official package lock, vulnerability scan, checkpoint branch, and explicit VM/release gates are preserved.
No Guard executable or Windows protection mechanism was run; user-owned files remain outside scope.
Endpoint stop now drains the actual run task before boundary release, independent of caller timeout.

scores.reasons: Before fixes, pipe-instance creation rights, listener handoff, leaf ACLs, and shutdown ordering left exploitable or reliability-critical gaps. After fixes, one authoritative writer, bounded codecs, LocalSystem-only DPAPI, exact SID ACLs, zero-gap listeners, and fail-closed startup are independently reviewed.
scores.verification_summary: Release solution build passed; 152/152 safe tests passed; NuGet vulnerable-package scan found none; independent focused review CLEAN.

scores.reasons: Before fixes, bootstrap, production IPC, fresh binding, native pipe rights, listener lifecycle, leaf ACLs, indirect admin membership, token integrity, and shutdown ordering contained exploitable or deployment-blocking gaps. After fixes, the code-only Stage 2 boundary is fail-closed and independently accepted.
scores.verification_summary: Exact staged tree 6a94830515b81a5ef0b53589b0aef615a86e772e; Release solution build; 159/159 safe tests; NuGet vulnerability audit clean; staged diff/allowlist/secret scans clean; two independent reviews found no P0/P1/P2. Real Windows behavior remains a disposable-VM gate.
